title: Tanker Hit by Multiple Projectiles Off Qatar; Iran Signals Full Hormuz Blockade
detail: UKMTO reports a tanker was struck by multiple projectiles off the north coast of Qatar. Iran separately claimed the route transporting oil through the Strait of Hormuz will be 'closed', marking the most direct threat of a full blockade since the crisis began. The incident escalates maritime risk across the Persian Gulf beyond the strait itself.

media.caption: Tanker struck by multiple projectiles off north coast of Qatar as Iran threatens full Hormuz closure

title: Tanker Attacks in Strait of Hormuz Drive Oil Prices Higher Amid Shortage Fears
detail: Growing shortage fears as sustained attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz push oil prices higher. Market reaction reflects the ongoing interdiction campaign targeting commercial shipping through the strait, raising concern about prolonged disruptions to global oil and food supply chains dependent on the Persian Gulf corridor.

title: Iran Scales Up Hormuz Attacks, Raising Pressure on Trump Administration as Midterms Approach
detail: Iran has intensified its attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Washington Post reporting, as the Trump administration faces mounting political pressure with US midterm elections approaching. The escalation marks a significant uptick in Iranian interdiction operations targeting commercial vessels transiting the strait.

title: CENTCOM: US Helped Transport Over 1.25 Billion Barrels of Oil Through Strait of Hormuz
detail: US Central Command (CENTCOM) reported that the United States helped facilitate the transport of over 1.25 billion barrels of oil through the Strait of Hormuz, underscoring the waterway's critical strategic importance amid Iran's ongoing interdiction campaign. The figure highlights the scale of US military escort and protection operations to keep commercial shipping flowing through the contested strait.
